{{Quote|As ''[the Signatories of Waymancy's]'' onslaught continued, their bloodlust deepened. At Upper Brightday, 10 million settlers saw their lives extinguished as the land was put to the torch.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Upper Brightday''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Upper Brightday system/Legends|Upper Brightday system]]. It was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Trestis sector/Legends|Trestis sector]], being located both in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of that region.<ref name="Location" /> Upper Brightday shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] celestial body [[Brightday]].<ref name="EGTW" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Waymancy Storm]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> Upper Brightday had been settled by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]. During that conflict, one of the parties constituting the [[Signatories of Waymancy]], the Republic's enemy at the time, [[Fire/Legends|incinerated]] the lands of the settlers on Upper Brightday, resulting in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of ten million colonists.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

At a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]], Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] noted the killing of the settlers at Upper Brightday as one of the [[Blood/Legends|bloodiest]] events of the Waymancy Storm.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> Upper Brightday fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Upper Brightday was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Upper Brightday [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-8.<ref name="Location" />
